ceo_letter.author: Christoffer Källberg
ceo_letter.title: Group CEO

promises.target: Maintain pace of 4 games per month
Conclude the year on a strong note
Continue product innovation and increasing monetisation

challenges.challenge: Margin compression due to business mix shift
Lower gross margins from third-party content

honesty_signals: Acknowledges sequential margin decline (81% vs 82% prior quarter)
Explains lower margins due to business mix changes transparently
References year-over-year comparability issues with third-party content
key_quotes: We have an exceptional team that we continuously expand, a proven strategy, and a fairly small market share from which to grow.

Given our changing business mix with increasing share of third-party content through our OpenRGS platform over the past quarters, which makes our year-over-year development less comparable, our sequential margin development gives a more accurate view.
Our current market share remains relatively small in a large and growing market, which provides substantial room for continued expansion.

key_narratives: Strong organic growth driven by game launches
Successful portfolio diversification reducing concentration risk
Strategic customer expansion with notable deals
OpenRGS platform as fast-growing strategic pillar
Margin pressure from business mix evolution
mda_analysis.management_interpretation: Management frames Q3 results as strong execution of growth strategy, emphasizing revenue growth acceleration, portfolio diversification, and customer expansion. The margin decline is positioned as a natural consequence of strategic business mix changes (more third-party content), with sequential performance being the more relevant metric.

segment_commentary.In-house games: Strong performer with 12 games released in Q3, continues to drive growth with higher margins
segment_commentary.Third-party/OpenRGS: Fast-growing but smaller revenue share, lower gross margins, strategic diversification play, 15 games released by 6 third-party studios in Q3

operational_highlights: Daily average rounds played increased 50% YoY
Top 10 games now account for 45% of GGR vs 60% last year (reduced concentration)
Portfolio expanded to 268 games vs 185 last year
48 new customer deals signed in quarter
Games available in over 35 locally licensed markets
concerns_mentioned: Lower gross margins from third-party content
Increased software license fees to third-party studios
Year-over-year comparability issues due to business mix changes

risks.risk: Changes in international and industry-specific regulations
Tax interpretation risks in multiple jurisdictions

guidance.commentary: Management reiterated the 30% revenue growth target and confirmed plans to maintain accelerated game launch pace of 4 per month. The guidance emphasizes organic growth through new game launches and customer expansion.

executive_summary: Hacksaw AB delivered strong Q3 2025 results with 39% revenue growth to EUR 52.0M and 29% EBIT growth to EUR 42.1M, driven by game launches, portfolio expansion, and customer acquisition. While margins compressed sequentially due to increased third-party content, management maintained confidence in the growth strategy and market opportunity.
key_highlights: Q3 revenue up 39% YoY to EUR 52.0M; YTD revenue up 52% to EUR 142.4M
Adjusted EBIT of EUR 42.1M (81% margin) in Q3, up 29% YoY
Daily rounds played increased 50% YoY; portfolio grew to 268 games
48 new customer deals signed including Betnacional and Ontario Lottery
Top 10 games concentration reduced to 45% of GGR from 60% (better diversification)
OpenRGS platform fast-growing with 6 third-party studios and 15 games in Q3
Cash and equivalents doubled to EUR 87.8M from EUR 44.0M at year-end
